name: prefix-cache-images

engine.branch: inkling2-loop-state (merged with the integration head 918e685: prefix cache, decode CUDA graphs and overlap, vision)

config.boot A: VISION=on PREFIX_CACHE=on, graphs and overlap default (on)

tests.filter: families::inkling2_loop:: (host: image rows through the real Engine over the simulated rank, the plan beside the tower, the backend's cache bookkeeping)
prefix_images_exact (two images; cuts 250, 364, 700, 1200, 1300; cold and resumed grids differ; state, last row, logits plane, decode bit-equal)
prefix_images_another_image_changes_the_reply (negative: another image changes the reply; a restore after image A keeps A's effect)

merged engine, graphs on: prefix_exact_at_cuts (20 cuts, digests unchanged by the merge; 10 captures, 140 replays), prefix_logits_planes_equal, prefix_restore_after_eviction, prefix_restore_beside_decoding_streams, prefix_long_prompt
cache on the merged engine with VISION=on PREFIX_CACHE=on: 5 prompts (31 to 73,169 tokens) and 2 shared-prefix pairs
after-text, other-image, text-first, image-first, two-images, concurrent: cached == uncached, 0 cached on uncached and cold
evict (24 prompts over 16 slots) and concurrent (3 restores + 1 cold) with the tower loaded and graphs on
--images: 28 replies of boot A equal boot B's uncached replies
--gate: 23 replies of gates.py cache --nonce xboot --big-tokens 66000, A against B
vision + diff: 3 image and 4 text replies of A equal B's

commands: git merge inkling2-loop  (engine worktree), git merge autoresearch/session-20261122  (recipe worktree)

NODE=node-3 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree> PKG=gb-model TEST_ENV='REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_DIR=/home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw' scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_loop_prefix prefix_images_exact prefix_images_another_image prefix_exact_at_cuts prefix_logits_planes_equal prefix_restore_after_eviction prefix_restore_beside_decoding_streams prefix_long_prompt

boot A: VISION=on PREFIX_CACHE=on ./inkling2mini.sh memwatch begin; ./inkling2mini.sh start; python3 bench/tools/cache_images.py --url http://node-3:8000 --model inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --out cache-images-on.json; python3 bench/tools/gates.py vision vision-on.json --url ...; ./inkling2mini.sh bench cache; python3 bench/tools/gates.py cache cache-xboot-on.json --nonce xboot --big-tokens 66000 --url ...; python3 bench/tools/cache_stress.py --out cache-stress-on.json ...; memwatch report; status; stop

boot B: VISION=on PREFIX_CACHE=off EXTRA_ENV='REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_GRAPHS=0 REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_OVERLAP=0' ./inkling2mini.sh start; python3 bench/tools/cache_images.py --reference-only --out cache-images-off.json ...; gates.py vision vision-off.json; gates.py cache cache-xboot-off.json --nonce xboot --big-tokens 66000 (its cache assertions fail: no cache); memwatch report; status; stop

python3 bench/tools/cache_compare.py --images cache-images-on.json cache-images-off.json; python3 bench/tools/cache_compare.py --gate cache-xboot-on.json cache-xboot-off.json; python3 bench/tools/gates.py diff vision-on.json vision-off.json
notes: Engine commit 6b6b824 is the clean merged tree the node built and ran for the live runs and for the GPU tests of this record (the earlier text-only GPU runs of ../2026-11-23-prefix-cache/ were on de2d4a3; the digests of the 20 cuts are unchanged by the merge). The first run of cache_images.py failed one assertion that was wrong (it expected the image to be outside the cached prefix by a margin of 80 tokens; the cache's end cut is 64 before the end of the prompt); the bound was corrected to 64 and the server restarted clean before the recorded run. Boot B's gates.py cache run is expected to report FAIL for every warm and shared hit (it has no cache): only its replies are used. The 880 MiB tower figure compares two builds (graphs off in both). A restore inside an image is not planned by the engine and is not exercised.
